articles.summary: More AI does not have to mean more pressure on water supplies. In this Big Technology podcast, Ecolab Chairman and CEO Christophe Beck challenges the assumption that rapidly expanding data centers must consume ever-greater amounts of water.
articles.title: Big Technology Podcast: How Much Water AI Data Centers Actually Use. And What Can Be Done About It

articles.summary: TechCrunch recently explored how alternative water sources can help data centers reduce their reliance on potable water. Michael Obradovitch, vice president of Data Center Global Accounts at Ecolab, explains more.
articles.title: TechCrunch: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?

articles.summary: On the SHIFT Podcast, Ecolab Chairman and CEO Christophe Beck joins Jennifer Strong to unpack just how deeply water is embedded in the physical infrastructure of AI — from manufacturing advanced chips and generating electricity to cooling the data centers where AI models run
articles.title: SHIFT Podcast: The Hidden Water Footprint Behind AI

articles.summary: As AI data centers expand, so are concerns about the enormous amounts of water needed to keep them running. In an interview with Fortune, Ecolab Chairman and CEO Christophe Beck explains how Ecolab is helping address that challenge.
articles.title: Fortune: A 103-year-old company says it has a plan to make AI data centers ‘water-neutral’
